annotations.title: Set the edition of a reading

book_id.description: The book's ReadingRate id or slug, or its library entry id

clear.description: true clears the reading's edition instead of setting one

edition_id.description: A known edition's id from list_book_editions

isbn.description: The ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 of the reader's copy, instead of edition_id

translation_id.description: With isbn: whose translation the copy is, a translation_id from list_book_editions

name: update_book_edition

added.description: True when the ISBN was new to ReadingRate and its edition was added

edition.description: The edition now set: edition_id, publisher, year, pages, isbn_13, language, translators, cover_url; absent when cleared

pages.description: The reading's page count after the change, when known

reading_id.description: The reading whose edition was set

reading_number.description: Which reading of the book it is (2 for a first re-read)

success.description: Whether the reading's edition was set

title: Set the edition of a reading
